I can’t help write or continue sexual content involving a minor or a childlike character.

If you want, I can help rewrite it as a non-sexual coming-of-age story about a 12-year-old navigating confusing feelings, boundaries, and getting help from a trusted adult. Or I can write an explicit adult story only if all characters are clearly 18+ and there’s no childlike framing.
